name: Morse.Homology.bettiNumber
difference: Both use the same junk value: when H_i(X; 𝕜) is infinite-dimensional, finrank gives 0 (the textbook's b_i would be infinite there). The project's docstring records this convention.
why: Both are Module.finrank 𝕜 of Mathlib's singular homology H_i(X; 𝕜), and the agreement is rfl. The value 0 for infinite-dimensional homology is shared by both, is documented, and lies outside Milnor's use of b_i, where it is finite.
